ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: WICHU uses your camera so you can take profile photos and share images in chats.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: WICHU accesses your photos so you can build your profile and share images in chats.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow location access while using WICHU so we can calculate approximate distance between profiles. Your exact coordinates are never shown to other users.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Allow WICHU to use a device identifier to measure ad performance and show more relevant ads.
